body.message:
As requested, we have successfully allocated an alternative unit for your stay.

However, if you still prefer not to proceed with the reservation and would like to explore refund options, we kindly recommend contacting Airbnb Support directly, as they will be able to assist you further with any refund-related inquiries.

Please let us know if you would like to proceed with the newly allocated unit, and we will be happy to assist you.
